summary: Snow Rothschild Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO of 20,000,000 units at $10.00/unit (gross $200M), closing on June 10, 2026. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50/share. Simultaneously, the sponsor purchased 2,250,000 private placement warrants ($1.00/warrant) for $2.25M. Net IPO proceeds plus private placement funds ($200M total) were placed in a trust account. On June 12, the underwriters partially exercised their over-allotment option, purchasing an additional 2,600,000 option units at $10.00 (extra $26M gross). This filing documents a blank-check company's initial listing and trust establishment. The SPAC will now have a limited window to identify and complete a de-SPAC business combination, with shareholder redemption rights. Watch for target announcement and proxy filing.
